title: Courgette Fritters #2
preamble:
2 medium courgettes, grated

2 tbsp self-raising flour

25g parmesan, finely grated

1 tbsp olive oil
method: In a bowl, combine the grated courgette, flour and parmesan. Shape into walnut-size balls, then flatten.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and add the oil. Fry the fritters for 2-3 mins on each side until golden brown.
